title: The Referee Who Fixed a World Cup Match With a Vibrating Watch Under His Sleeve
hook: A referee pocketed millions by signaling illegal plays using a hidden vibrator synced to a betting algorithm—no one caught it for three years.

title: The Doping Lab That Used a Leech's Saliva to Dissolve Blood Clots in Cyclists
hook: A secret lab harvested leech anticoagulants to flush clot-forming EPO from cyclists' blood—but the side effects turned their veins to jelly.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gross biological detail meets high-performance cheating—disgust and curiosity drive shares.

title: The Coach Who Trained a Marathon Runner With Electric Shocks During Sleep

why_this_can_go_viral: Blatant athlete abuse with a shocking method sparks outrage and morbid fascination.

title: The Doping Lab That Harvested a Squid's Axon to Speed Up a Boxer's Reflexes
